start_frame: Along the curtain-to-table axis: Alice turning in the near frame to look back up the hall, the glass table standing away from her down the flooded floor.
end_frame: The same frame held on the look: the 0.715 m tabletop now a high shelf far above her head with the golden key a spark on top of it — still the brightest thing in the hall — and her tiny reflection doubled in the wet flagstone below.
constraint_honoured: 'The one image of the scene. Still the brightest thing in the hall.'
movement_note: The space lens and a held frame keep the table, the key and her all measurable in one image; a move would spend the distance the shot exists to state.
